Panel classification: A: photograph; B: plot; C: micrograph, plot; D: plot; E: plot; F: micrograph.

Figure 6 caption: (A) Representative ex vivo images of lungs from SNL mice, control (no Cre) or infected with Ad-Cre (11 months post infection), 24 h post injection with PDBA ICG 5.3 ultra pH-sensitive (UPS) nanoparticle. Bright-field images (left) and the corresponding ICG fluorescence images (right) are shown. (B) Quantification of mean ICG fluorescence intensity... (C) H&E image of the lung section from Fig. 3A), with ICG signal on the same section, and RNAscope of Tmprss11b (red) on a serial section. Also shown are spatial plots depicting enrichment of Cd68 (macrophage marker) and Spp1 (immunosuppressive macrophage marker) transcripts in these regions. Scale bar, 1 mm. (D) GSEA plots... (E) Bar graph... (F) Representative ICG fluorescence images (left) and the corresponding immunohistochemistry (IHC) validation of HMOX1 and MSR1 (right) in SNL lung sections. The staining was repeated with lung sections from different mice (n = 2, biological replicates). Scale bar, 500 um.

Panel C contains 5 images left to right: H&E image, ICG signal image, Tmprss11b RNAscope image (all with a black scale bar visible under the H&E image only, labeled "Low pH regions" annotation, scale bar 1mm stated in caption applies to the row), and two spatial plots (Cd68, Spp1 expression heatmaps overlaid on tissue). No scale bar number visible printed on any image itself in panel C.

Panel F contains two rows, each with ICG fluorescence image (left, no scale bar visible) and IHC image (right, with a black scale bar at bottom right corner, no number printed on the image itself). Caption states scale bar 500 um applies to panel F.

Panel A photographs of whole lungs, no scale bar present and none expected.

Panel classification: A: photograph; B: plot; C: micrograph, plot; D: plot; E: plot; F: micrograph.

Panel B: bar graph showing mean ICG fluorescence intensity for two groups (No Cre, Adeno Cre), with error bars (SD) and individual data points overlaid as blue and red dots.

Panel C: spatial plots (Cd68, Spp1) are heatmap-style spatial expression plots overlaid on tissue sections, not bar/mean plots.

Panel D: GSEA enrichment plots (line plots), three panels, no bars/means - these are enrichment score running plots, exempt as line plots.

Panel E: bar graph showing Log2 fold change for 9 genes (C1qb, Gpnmb, C3ar1, Apoe, Ctsl, Fabp4, Trem2, Hmox1, Msr1) with p-values listed above each bar, no error bars, no individual data points shown (appears to be single bar per gene representing aggregate fold change from differential expression analysis, not a replicate-based mean).

Panel classification: A: photograph; B: plot; C: micrograph, plot; D: plot; E: plot; F: micrograph.

Panel B: bar graph with error bars (visible SD bars) for two groups, caption states "Unpaired t test with Welch's correction was used for the analysis, P = 0.0281. Plot represents mean ± SD."

Panel C spatial plots (Cd68, Spp1): heatmap color scale (log2 expression), no error bars.

Panel D: GSEA enrichment plots - line plots, no error bars, these are deterministic enrichment score curves.

Panel E: bar graph of log2 fold change per gene with p-values listed, no visible error bars on the bars.
